description: Reduce volumetric rate for Xcel customers consistent with electric space heating vs. non-electric space heating relative rate difference. Source (Xcel Energy MN interim rate notice, docket 21-630): https://www.xcelenergy.com/staticfiles/xe-responsive/Company/Rates%20&%20Regulations/21-11-204%20MN%20Interim%20Electric%20Rates%20Final.pdf. Percent reduction = 1 - 9.491/12.640 = 24.9%, the proposed 2024 residential winter electric heating energy rate (9.491 cents/kWh) vs. the standard winter energy rate (12.640 cents/kWh). Fixed charge = $2.00/month higher customer charge for electric heating (overhead line $11.50 vs. $9.50; underground $13.50 vs. $11.50 proposed) = $24/year. Rates in the notice are proposed, not final approved rates.

description:
Pepco Maryland seasonal distribution rate design reducing volumetric delivery charges during winter billing cycles to support beneficial electrification. Pepco Maryland Electric Tariff, Schedule R (page 3), effective Aug 28, 2026: winter (Nov-May) kWh charge $0.04328 vs. summer $0.08760, a $0.04432/kWh difference. Seasonal design applies to all Schedule R customers (no heat-pump-specific rate), so the reduction is applied to heating load, which is concentrated in winter.
https://www.pepco.com/cdn/assets/v3/assets/bltbb7c204688a1a6a8/blte8a580e4cc79e2c4/6a872c5eae5697fe1cdfdc73/2026-08-20_MASTER_MD_Pepco_Tariff_Book_.pdf?branch=prod_alias
